name: Le Grand Bornand
description: Le Grand Bornand is one of the most authentic villages in the Aravis range — a real farming community where cows still outnumber tourists. Known as the 'capital of Reblochon' cheese. The ski area (70km) is on the Chinaillon plateau above the village. Quiet, traditional, excellent value.

overview.atmosphere: Charming Haute-Savoie village, traditional farming community, good family skiing. Home of Reblochon cheese.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Sledging, snowshoeing, paragliding, weekly market, ice skating
